$comment: Behavioural parity vectors for the voucher-lifecycle rules — CLAUDE.md §13.4.
One table, spent by scripts/check-mirrors.js against BOTH implementations:
`actions` is the EXHAUSTIVE cross-product of the six facts a decision turns on:
status (5) x everPosted x isArchived x activeReferences(0|2) x allowCancel(unset|false) x allowDelete(unset|false)
so no branch can be missing and no two rows can duplicate each other's inputs.
`expect` is the rule RESTATED from the doc comments and §4.9's two lifecycle rules — not read off
either implementation — so the table can disagree with the code instead of agreeing by construction.
`why` carries prose on the rows that pin something notable (BUG-0024, the asymmetries) and a derived
label on the rest. See ./README.md. Add vectors in the same commit as a rule change.

actions.why: a DRAFT archives even with a live reference — the switch returns before the reference check, deliberately: nothing that never posted can be legitimately depended on, and rule 1 is about documents leaving the BOOKS. An asymmetry with the cancelled case that a reader would otherwise take for a bug

recall.why: the maker pulls their own pending voucher back
the submitter may recall it too — they are the person who sent it
a third party may not recall — a checker who disagrees rejects, which is recorded against them
only a voucher waiting for approval can be recalled
a draft is already where recall would put it
a cancelled voucher is not recallable
no maker and no submitter recorded: nobody may recall it
